dmp.description:
M-channels, where Kv7.2 constitutes one of its subunits, are pivotal in neuronal excitability, as their dysfunction has been implicated in various neurodevelopmental and epileptic syndromes. Besides, Stargazin has been identified as a regulator of M-channels and neuronal excitability, and its absence results in compromised M-channel function. Stargazin is a transmembrane AMPA receptor regulatory protein (TARP).
Our goal is to further characterize the Stargazin-Kv7.2 complex, and to test its functional significance to ultimately explore its potential as a therapeutic target for epilepsy.
